title: Vascular anastomosis
summary: Control a vessel and perform an end-to-side anastomosis.

anchors.name: right_groin
anchors.label: right groin, above the inguinal ligament

anchors.name: right_leg_medial
anchors.label: medial right thigh, along the great saphenous vein

steps.title: WHO Time Out
steps.prompt: Before skin incision for a right femoral exposure, the team pauses. What must be confirmed aloud?

choices.text: Patient identity, the procedure, the site and side, and antibiotics given in the last 60 minutes
choices.feedback: Correct: the Time Out confirms who, what and where, and that prophylaxis is in.

choices.text: Only that the consent form is signed
choices.feedback: The signature alone does not prevent wrong-site surgery.

choices.text: Nothing: the site was marked on the ward
choices.feedback: Marking does not replace the Time Out.

steps.hint: The site is the right groin. All three phases of the WHO checklist are mandatory.

steps.title: Control
steps.prompt: Before opening the artery you must have…

steps.title: Give heparin before clamping
steps.hint: Systemic heparin, then wait before clamping.

steps.title: Suture direction
steps.prompt: On the arterial side, the needle passes…

steps.title: Run the anastomosis
steps.hint: Fine polypropylene, heel and toe first.

steps.title: Flush, release the clamps in order and check for bleeding and a distal pulse
